scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w infra && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w infra && npm test -w frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w frontend && npm run deploy -w infra
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run trace
